cost_accounting: Each evaluator policy run emits both base-cost and doubled-cost evidence; doubled costs are not separate material configurations.
registration_rule: Every activated policy or neighbor requires a separate organizer registration before its result is read; failed and interrupted configurations consume budget.

core_stage.activation: first policy run after family registration and A5 freeze
core_stage.pass_gate: Every preregistered positive and broad core-alpha minimum in ablations.json must pass before any control activates.
core_stage.failure_action: Falsify the mechanism; do not register a single-control, combined-control, or neighbor configuration.

controlled_stage.activation: only after the no-control core-alpha gate passes
controlled_stage.promotion_rule: Only the fixed combined-policy team05-crtr-base-v1 may be promoted, and only after every official and Team-05 non-neighborhood gate passes.

neighbor_stage.activation: only after the combined-policy base passes every official and Team-05 gate except the neighborhood gates

stop_rule: No controls after core failure, no neighbors after combined-policy failure, and no private submission after any final hard-gate failure.
